heading: UNITY: THE HOA RISES
paragraph_one: I just want to rub in Mikie's big face. This dude did NOT believe I could get this donek, and yet here I am, typing this right now, with faith that I will see it up on my big fat google chrome window. DOWN WITH THE HOA!! THE REVOLUTION STARTS NOW!!
paragraph_two: I'm sorry Mikie. I didn't mean it. Please don't take it out on me. Actually this is Isaac, I'm not even Aaron, I swear. Do take it out on my, Isaac. My name is Isaac, I said all of this. I took over Aaron's computer and typed all of this out.
